title: Sintel - Open Movie by Blender Foundation
summary: Sintel is a 15-minute animated fantasy short made by the Blender Foundation to develop and showcase Blender, funded by community donations and released under Creative Commons.
why: HN cites it as an example of what open-source tools can produce and as freely licensed footage for demoing multimedia software.

quote.text: People have been making cool movies with it for years
